answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by establishing a staked trust harbor where every new identity must deposit bonded tokens into a timelocked haven. A peer-verified reputation rating functions like a rare pearl that grows only through sustained, attested interactions. If an adversary attempts to flood the network with fake personas, the cumulative collateral cost scales linearly per identity, imposing an unsustainable financial penalty and severe slashing risks on attacker capital.
